summary: 84/84原PNG逐張實看並核bytes/SHA/尺寸；17張保存真照覆蓋九款。四款需修：Bishop Lloyd Rows廊道、Harrods屋頂量體、Liberty木框／真採光井、Willow弧凸玻璃窗；五款僅候選層級通過並保留中度建議。沒有全波或發布意義。

severityDefinition.high: Blocks candidate visual finalization because frozen major identification or intended visible structure is absent/illegible.
severityDefinition.medium: Actionable refinement/readability issue; not an additional candidate blocker in this limited review.

inspection.viewMethod: Each of 72 native singles was separately returned as its own view_image original image block, then each of 9 near originals and all3 complete original contacts were also viewed. Contacts were not used to substitute for single-image inspection.
inspection.referenceLimit: Only the 17 named real photographs below were independently viewed. Existing25-file ledger was preserved and read, but not all25 assets were re-viewed by this reviewer. No Silver references reviewed; C3 silver-1.jpg is a render and not counted.
inspection.contactScope: contact-comparison provides real old leaves only at orientations0/2 for the nine listed pairs. No claim of all previous buildings or old r1/r3 inspection.
inspection.nightInterpretation: Standalone *-night.png files are transparent light overlays. contact-night and right half of near use source preview composition: day at alpha .25 plus night at full alpha on #20312e. They are not captured installed-game night scenes.

independentFileChecks.limitation: Hard alpha and non-edge bounds do not certify architectural correctness, internal seam quality, light fixture placement, RGB palette or whole-game performance. Night/day opaque ratios below include shared paving and are not building-only luminance scores.

globalVisualAssessment.massingAndRoofDiversity: Nine silhouettes and roof organizations visibly differ: ellipse dome; low five-ridge market+tower; enclosed crossing-roof market; paired timber gables; low double-shop arcade; tall terracotta department block; tall timber gable department block; stepped modern glazing block; narrow white shop with rear annex. This is more than recolouring.
globalVisualAssessment.fourDirections: All36 day views and36 light layers inspected. Moving asymmetric parts (porches, tower, entrance, dome offset, stone turrets, curved stair, rear annex) and source world-coordinate kit(view) support real geometry rotations. Symmetric parts naturally repeat. No image mirror/rotate shortcut found in read source; no execution-based installation equality proved.
globalVisualAssessment.croppingSeamsVoids: No source-canvas edge crop or obvious catastrophic outer seam found in these originals. Intentional galleries/loggias are not mistaken for holes. Liberty's wells instead show a blocked depth issue; Willow's opaque bow is a surface-facing issue.
globalVisualAssessment.density: Halifax glass/roof/dormer lines and Burlington transverse arches alias into over-dense highlights; Liberty and Harrods equal-weight window grids suppress major hierarchy.
globalVisualAssessment.night: No night alpha outside opaque day pixels. No entire-building bloom seen in the preview composition. Harrods dense lights and large central window plus Danum ribbon lights dominate, but structure remains partly separated; Willow/Liberty already weak structural identification becomes weaker at night.
globalVisualAssessment.oldGeometryDuplication: For all9 selected old/new pairs at r0/r2, no direct geometric copy seen. Shared native palette/windows/roof primitives recur. This is a limited comparison, not exhaustive historical asset deduplication.

models.rotations: 圓弧樓梯與高中央塊在四向換位，背側階梯輪廓完整；支持真幾何。
models.clippingSeamsHoles: 未見畫布裁切或大面脫縫。
models.night: 橫窗有高覆蓋暖光，支撐像素皆在日圖；分層仍能讀出，無白色泛光遮蔽整體。

oldComparison.result: 中央退階＋弧玻璃梯柱對舊兩端方塔／中間低廳明確不同。

findings.issue: 樓梯柱的淺色實心比例偏高、玻璃帶過窄，曲面與黃磚／Vitriolite對比不足。

references.visible: 薄白框、通高深色玻璃樓梯柱、弧角橫窗與退階側翼

findings.suggestion: 後續優先放寬樓梯柱深色玻璃、收細白梃，連接橫窗曲角；中央高層與退階量體保留，不加古典細節。

models.mass: 窄高白四層本體、深水平檐與低背附屋可辨；與舊Finsbury寬低院落不同。
models.windows: 不等寬上層窗有設計；核心首層弧凸鉛格窗卻在成圖成為不透明灰褐板，不具照片可見的高密細鉛格玻璃。
models.roof: 主樓簡平頂＋背部低坡附屋有高低差；後附屋四坡／玻璃僅文字支持，不能說已由街照核實。
models.rotations: r0/r3顯露白正立面及空白凸窗；r1/r2看到低背附屋，為真幾何換面。
models.clippingSeamsHoles: 未見畫布裁切；凸窗不透並非材質審美選擇，來源法線／條件有明確錯配。
models.night: 上層與地層有光，弧凸窗整片暗／不發光，支持它沒有正確得到玻璃面的視覺發現。

oldComparison.result: 窄高單樓＋小附屋和舊寬低幾翼院落不同，無直接幾何重複。

findings.issue: 首層弧凸鉛格窗在r0/r3與near讀成完整灰褐不透明凸板，照片的主要辨識點缺失。

sourceCorroboration.detail: bow點序順時針；planBlock使用(nx,ny)=(dy/len,-dx/len)，五段外弧面的ny均負，只有閉合背面ny=1。for(G of bow) if(G.ny>0...)因而只在背面加窗，與成圖灰褐外弧一致。此計算僅讀來源座標，未執行建模或遊戲。

findings.suggestion: 修正本模型弧面點序／外法線與加窗判定，使玻璃／鉛梃實際覆在可見外弧面。保留白外框及下方方格細節，原生圖至少要看出分離玻璃帶；四向日夜重烘後再審。
